patterns.note: Full-width content sections with alternating background colors (white, light green, light beige) are used to visually segment information and create clear hierarchy throughout the page.

Prominent, bold sans-serif headings are used for section titles, often in a dark grey, contrasting with lighter weight sans-serif body text and smaller uppercase labels for sub-sections or feature descriptions.
A core brand palette of light green, white, and dark grey is consistently applied, with vibrant accent colors (orange, blue) strategically used for CTAs and illustrative icons.

The hero section features a dynamic video background that automatically cycles through different models wearing various glasses, creating an engaging and illustrative introduction to the product's versatility.

A 'trust bar' containing key value propositions (reviews, returns, quality) is initially part of the hero section but becomes sticky at the top of the viewport, just below the main navigation, after the user scrolls down.
Product collections are presented in horizontal carousels with clear navigation arrows and pagination dots, allowing users to browse multiple items within a dedicated section without navigating away.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a video element that automatically plays and loops through a sequence of different clips, showcasing product variations and diverse models without requiring user interaction.

A key information bar is implemented with a 'sticky' positioning effect: it starts as a static element within the hero, but once its scroll position reaches the top of the viewport, it transitions to a fixed position, remaining visible as the user continues to scroll.

Content sections are built using full-width containers with distinct background colors and generous vertical padding, often employing a two-column layout for image and text, or a grid for product displays and feature cards.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) establish clear hierarchy, supported by readable body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons, input fields, and image containers, contributing to an approachable and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with ample vertical padding between major sections and comfortable internal spacing within content blocks, creating a clean and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its dynamic hero video, which immediately showcases the core product concept of interchangeable glasses on a diverse range of models, effectively communicating versatility and inclusivity. This is powerfully reinforced by the 'trust bar' that becomes sticky on scroll, ensuring key value propositions are always visible.
